notes.title: Solution for Missing Save Files
notes.notes:
Update to the latest version.

On Steam, right-click on the Flash Doll -> Properties -> Disable Cloud Saves.

Navigate to the save file path: %appdata%..\LocalLow\GameStar\FlashDoll, delete the small-sized save files, then restart the game.

notes.title: Online features are now live!
notes.notes:
Added the ability to connect devices, allowing players to engage in online PvP with blind boxes as stakes. The winner takes all blind boxes, with a chance for them to transform into shiny blind boxes or new blind boxes. Shiny blind boxes guarantee shiny outfits and shiny plushies.

New Features:
Display stands can now hold blind boxes.
Added in-room chat functionality.
Classic elevator issue: The lift's ascent now more accurately mimics real elevator behavior.
Fixed a bug where settings would not save.
Fixed an issue where help was always displayed.
Chip Adjustments:
Modified the Enlightenment Chip effect: When all skills are on cooldown, randomly refreshes the cooldown of one skill. If the same skill is refreshed consecutively, increases its cooldown by 1.2 seconds, stackable.
Modified the Johnson Chip effect: Restores 0.5% of lost health per second.
Reduced the health boost from certain attributes.

notes.title: Con búp bê dễ thương chính thức ra mắt, Ciallo～(∠・ω＜)⌒☆
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that after two months of careful adjustments and optimizations, our game has finally completed its EA (Early Access) phase and is officially entering full release! Thank you all for your support and feedback during the EA phase, which allowed us to continually improve and enhance the game experience. Today, the game is officially launched!
